rules.logic: XQL(Cisco ASA Informational and Debug Log Volume Collapse) AND count(BIOC(Cisco ASA WebVPN Client Authentication Session From Modeled Peer IP)) >= 6 by xdm.source.ipv4 within 1h — fires when the same Cisco ASA appliance shows an Informational/Debug syslog-volume collapse below its trailing baseline AND at least 6 WebVPN client-authentication session-start matches from a single modeled peer IP within a one-hour window. The per-window cadence threshold lives here in the correlation (a Correlation Rule / scheduled query is where an N-per-window count belongs); the referenced BIOC matches each individual 716001 session-start event. This stitches the absence-of-signal defense-evasion indicator to the WebVPN C2 channel into one edge-appliance-compromise incident anchored to the appliance host and the beacon peer.
rules.name: Edge Appliance Telemetry Collapse with WebVPN C2 Beacon
